in_marathi.name: Gajjar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gajjar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'gajas' meaning 'elephant'. This name is associated with strength, power, and stability, representing the mighty and unyielding elephant.
